description: Benemérito Cuerpo de Bomberos de Panamá (Panama Fire Department) publishes a nationwide list of about 92 fire stations with their regional zone, station name, location, street address, telephone numbers, province, district and corregimiento, in CSV (semicolon separated), XLSX and PDF. Coverage: the whole of Panama; the portal record was last modified on 2021-02-23 and the reference date of the list is not stated. Format and access: XLSX, PDF, CSV, downloadable without registration from the Panama national open data portal; the portal also serves the metadata through a public API. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Creative Commons Attribution; cost: free. Caveats: the list has addresses but no coordinates, so it must be geocoded before mapping; it is a 2021 snapshot, so newer or closed stations are not reflected; no vehicle, staffing or response-time data are included; the CSV is not UTF-8 encoded. Simulation uses: fire-station siting and coverage analysis, emergency-response and evacuation models, and accessibility studies that join stations to road networks and population. Related catalogue records: Panama national open data catalogue (data-panama-national-open-data-catalogue); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
